front: Four ways water is lost from soil

back: No oxygen → poor root respiration → little water and nutrient uptake → yellowing, wilting, root death.
Nitrification stops; denitrifying bacteria turn nitrate into nitrogen gas.
Open ditches, tile drains, mole drains, rubble drains, ridges and raised beds, subsoiling pans.
